capabilities: insert a live table of contents code block that rebuilds from headings as you type
write a plain Markdown table of contents between markers that refreshes itself after heading edits
fold TOC branches and highlight the section currently being read
adopt existing TOC lists from other plugins or hand-written heading links
convert a TOC between live block and Markdown form while keeping its options
extras: Migration notes for three earlier TOC plugins; warns that only one plugin can render a code block language, so Automatic Table of Contents must be disabled first. Includes an accessibility section (aria attributes, reduced motion) and CSS variables for theming.
intentEvidence: table-of-contents blocks written for Automatic Table of Contents work as they are
problem: Obsidian's outline lives in a sidebar and code-block TOCs do not render as lists in Publish or exports, so in-note tables of contents go stale or disappear.

relations.evidence: table-of-contents blocks written for Automatic Table of Contents work as they are
Turns a list of heading links (from Table of Contents, Insta TOC or by hand)
Insta TOC: the same command turns its block into a marked list.
Style Settings can change the indent.

summary: Table of contents generator that renders a live, foldable heading list inside a note, or a self-updating plain Markdown list for Publish and exports.
